This analysis explores physical measurements of penguin species observed at the Palmer Station in Antarctica. We examine how body mass, bill dimensions, and flipper length vary across three species: Adélie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo.

Data: \[Palmer Penguins\](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/), Palmer Station Antarctica LTER. The dataset is distributed under the \[CC0 1.0 Universal License\](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
```

## Running Code

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
# Clean dataset by removing missing values for analysis
penguins_clean <- penguins |> 
  drop_na(species, body_mass_g, bill_length_mm, flipper_length_mm)

```

```{r}
#| label: summary-table

penguins_clean |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    mean_body_mass_g = round(mean(body_mass_g), 1),
    mean_bill_length_mm = round(mean(bill_length_mm), 1),
    mean_flipper_length_mm = round(mean(flipper_length_mm), 1)
  ) |> 
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Species", "Sample Size", "Mean Mass (g)", "Mean Bill Length (mm)", "Mean Flipper Length (mm)")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: body-mass-distribution

penguins_clean |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    x = "Species",
    y = "Body Mass (g)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-penguin-mass
#| fig-cap: "Body mass vs. flipper length across Antarctic penguin species."

ggplot(penguins_clean, aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    x = "Flipper Length (mm)",
    y = "Body Mass (g)",
    color = "Species"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
